integrity: All calculations and proofs are newly stated here; no claim of independent verification, external certification, or definitive novelty is made.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives 2^N-1 explicit inverse states, not the entire inverse fiber. Open-target persistence may fail at the stated finite exceptional parameter set, which is not claimed minimal. Only all-to-all zero-phase-lag attractive updates are covered. Earlier work already found the qualitative injectivity boundary. Full text of a close three-oscillator 2025 paper was not accessible, and historical priority needs independent review.
title: Exponentially many inverse branches at the discrete Kuramoto folding threshold
